verdict.rationale: DeepInfra documents a drop-in OpenAI-compatible endpoint (base_url swap, same SDK, same code) which is the mechanism most coding agents and agent frameworks rely on for provider integration, so it is plausible to plug DeepInfra into such tools. However, the evidence pack contains no first-party guide naming or walking through specific coding agents/agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen, Cursor, Continue) — only generic OpenAI SDK compatibility docs. Missing for 10: named integration guides/tutorials for specific coding agents or agent frameworks, and independent confirmation that such integrations work end-to-end.
